name: health-data-steward
description: Personal health data steward. Turns body-weight scale photos, meal photos and dictation into structured rows in a local SQLite database, then produces a daily HTML report with trend review and next-day lifestyle advice. Photos are used only to extract numbers and are not archived. Runs entirely on the local machine.

displayDescription.en: Turns your scale and meal photos into structured rows in a local database, then reports daily activity, sleep, weight and nutrition trends with next-day advice.
displayDescription.zh: 把你的体重秤与餐食照片取数入库，按日汇总活动、睡眠、体重趋势，给出次日饮食与运动建议。数据全在本机。同一套技能也可直接装到豆包等支持 Skill 的 AI 助手上。
